thought.text: The base images are fully populated (data-structures installed via the local-wheels fix). Now relaunching wave-2:

reasoning_content:
The base executor image has demospipes_data_structures 1.0.3 installed. In other words, the pip wheel step in the core Dockerfile was resolved somehow... Let me re-check the core Dockerfile in wave 1:

```
COPY pyproject.toml README.md ./
COPY src/ ./src/
RUN --mount=type=secret... pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --wheel-dir /wheels --extra-index-url "https://${PIP_BMDS_INDEX_USERNAME}:${PIP_BMDS_INDEX_PASSWORD}@<REDACTED>" .
```

Wait, in wave 1, fix_pipwheel.py was executed against demospipes-base-executors — it replaced that RUN with a local wheel version:
```
COPY ./local-wheels/ /local-wheels/
RUN pip wheel --no-cache-dir --no-input --wheel-dir /wheels --find-links=/local-wheels .
```
And local_wheels() built data-structures. That's why it worked.

Now, let me restart wave 2.
